mapper.sql: m.id, m.submission_id, m.uploader_id, m.location_id, m.object_key, m.thumbnail_key, m.title, m.description, m.shot_at, m.tags, m.status, m.view_count, m.like_count, m.favorite_count, m.download_count, m.created_at, m.updated_at

where.if: AND ( m.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT FROM media m WHERE m.id = #{mediaId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media WHERE location_id = #{locationId} AND status = 1

SELECT m.id, m.title, m.location_id, l.name AS location_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.thumbnail_key, ''), m.object_key) AS thumbnail_key, m.shot_at, m.view_count, m.like_count, m.favorite_count FROM media m LEFT JOIN location l ON l.id = m.location_id WHERE m.location_id = #{locationId} AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.shot_at DESC, m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT FROM media m
ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT id, tags FROM media WHERE LOCATE( CONCAT('|', #{tag}, '|'), CONCAT('|', COALESCE(tags, ''), '|') ) > 0 ORDER BY id
